description: Hosts whose terms forbid automated access (design section 6, decision D7). No source binding, agent fetch or fact source_url may use them; a host also covers its subdomains. A URL or handle on these hosts may be stored as a value only when its source_url is the operator's own site, a landing page or a report site.
